questions.question: When King David and Israel carried the ark of God out of Abinadab's house, what did they carry it on?
When the oxen pulling the cart with the ark of God stumbled, what did a man named Uzzah do?

answers.text: He took hold of the ark
He jumped down to calm the oxen
He shouted for everyone to stop

questions.question: After the LORD struck down Uzzah, King David took the ark of God with him to the City of David. True or false?
While the ark of God stayed at Obed-edom's house for three months, what happened to his household?

answers.text: The LORD blessed it and all he owned
His family grew afraid and left
Sickness spread all through his house
